Source:     http://www.brutman.com/mTCP/download/mTCP-src_2026-10-10.zip
            https://github.com/mbbrutman/mTCP
The complete corresponding source of the binaries in this directory is
MTCPSRC.ZIP (= mTCP-src_2026-10-10.zip, unmodified). The binaries are the
unmodified files of mTCP_2026-10-10.zip from the home page.

USOS only adds its own packet driver USOSPKT.COM (GPL-3.0-or-later,
Copyright (C) 2026 Maksymilian and the USOS Authors) and NETSTART.BAT;
mTCP talks to it through the Packet Driver interface (INT 60h).
